For involutions a,b with |ab|=13, aa^b=(ab)^2 and (aa^b)^6a=(ab)^12a=ba a=b. Thus the halved generators recover b. Both pair-order arrays and generated-group equality are checked afresh.

I computed the seven proper standard subgroups as literal element sets and every one of49 pairwise set intersections for each marking. The remaining15 pairs have at least one full subset and hold by subgroup inclusion. Hence all64 ordered subset pairs hold for each triple.

The author checks actual product sets, not generated products. Independently I enumerate left cosets yPj,zPk meeting Pi. Every incident pair has precisely one common point in Pi, and the number of anchored chambers equals |Pi| for all three anchors. Thus all pairwise incident triples have a common representative. The written y^-1 z=uv argument is correct with y u=z v^-1.

IP gives Borel1 and rank-two residue group <xi,xj>; panels have index2. Each such residue is connected because its two involutions generate; global chamber connectivity follows from generation. Singletons/pairs extend to chambers and the common-representative test covers maximal flags. A chamber-fixing type-preserving automorphism fixes its unique adjacent chamber at each type, hence every chamber and element. The regular group is therefore the full type-preserving automorphism group. String C-group/polytope correspondence is retained and explicitly invoked.
String marking orders6,2,13 give type{6,13}; halved orders6,6,13 are all>2, so its rank-three diagram is a triangle. This is the exact source nonlinearity target.

All13 maximal orders and word orders11/13 are checked, but are unnecessary for the actual direct generation proof. Their classification completeness is retained only for the alternative argument, not silently used as a substitute for P=G.

Fi22 alone supplements the source possible exceptions. Fi24prime is untouched. The ten affirmative cases retain their own separate acceptance. Two full GAP programs and the literal witness are required; complete driver and embedded optional validation are not pruned. No Lean, ratio, classification proof, priority, or automatic credit is claimed.
